OCC Tuesday Slow N' Easy Ride

Camillus, NY · Road · Social

OCC Tuesday Slow N' Easy Ride is a road and social group ride in Camillus, NY. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Reed Webster Park.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: leisurely. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OCC Tuesday Slow N' Easy Ride group ride

A beginner ride on flat, low-traffic roads west of Syracuse. Two experienced riders lead every group and nobody gets left behind. Any bike works; families with kids are welcome. A faster option leaves from the same park the same night.
